name: local-llm-memory
description: Pick an embedding backend and vector/memory store for an agent running on a self-hosted model (LM Studio/Ollama/llama.cpp) instead of a cloud API — fully offline, sized against the same machine's RAM/VRAM the chat model already uses. One deterministic stdlib script scores ChromaDB+ONNX MiniLM, sqlite-vec, FAISS, plain JSONL-lexical, and managed-cloud-vector-DB against expected record count, RAM budget, and an offline-required flag, disqualifying the cloud option outright when offline is required. Ships a reference on the local-LLM-specific failure modes (shared-inference-slot queueing, silent embedding-dimension mismatch after a model swap, offline claims that still phone home). Distinct from memory-engineering (architecture-family choice, hosting-agnostic) and agent-memory (cloud-first L0-L3 hook ladder).
